structure:
A single 24-line Markdown ruling file (workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-11-10b.md) from Sam, dated 10 November 2026, the second ruling of that day. It runs: a heading (line 1); one framing sentence saying Sam decided on the review of the obligation model and test tidy-up rows, that the review is workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/stale-theme-review/findings.json, and that a second agent checked each verdict (lines 3-4); Sam's verbatim quote, two lines of lower-case blockquote holding three decisions in one breath - 'no, move them to the theme that does the work. yes drop obligation model row. the return links consider as blocked waiting on the save and continue theme which is currently being built on another machine.' (lines 6-7); then a '## Decided' heading (line 9) and the main session's reading as 3 numbered claims (lines 11-24). Claim 1 drops the obligation model row inc-245, with its reasoning (main already tells a hard stop from a submission check; each page refuses a missing required answer; the review refuses submission; both save buttons make the same checks, citing inc-232; the one all-or-nothing group in V4, accompanying documents, is refused when half-filled; the model has had allOrNothingOfIds and anyOfIds since September), what is lost (the manifest never names 'mandatory to proceed' as its own marking, and no single test proves the markings together), that req-2206 and req-2207 are out of scope, and that the obligation-model theme is removed (lines 11-16). Claim 2 moves the overview and review class-list checks to the theme that does the work: the hub's totals box, button and caption line-height checks to overview-and-review inc-098, the review's visually-hidden and summary-card class checks and the review's last-card screenshot to overview-and-review inc-101, with the live animals class-name row inc-234 keeping the rest and dropping the overview and transit countries screenshots as already on the tests repo's main (lines 17-21). Claim 3 blocks the return links row inc-235 until the save and continue work has merged, naming EUDPA-774, branch feat/EUDPA-774-save-and-continue-through-journey and workarea workareas/shared/eudpa-774, and takes its commodities half out of the row as already on main (lines 22-24). No claim is marked New or as replacing a conflict; the file carries no evidence table and no other quote. The review the ruling answers covers four rows (inc-245, inc-234, inc-235, inc-236) while the ruling and its claims name only the first three, so inc-236 is a point the file touches by reference and leaves open. Scope is the whole file, so nothing is left out. It is one part: 24 lines, well inside what one agent reads word for word.

Extracted in 1 part:

(2) The framing sentence, lines 3-4, saying Sam decided on the review of the obligation model and test tidy-up rows, that the review is stale-theme-review/findings.json, and that a second agent checked each verdict. (3) Sam's verbatim blockquote, lines 6-7, two lower-case lines holding three decisions in one breath and naming no increment, row, requirement, ticket, branch, workarea or theme: 'no, move them to the theme that does the work. yes drop obligation model row. the return links consider as blocked waiting on the save and continue theme which is currently being built on another machine.' (4) The '## Decided' heading, line 9, and the main session's reading as three numbered claims, lines 11-24: claim 1 drops the obligation model row inc-245 with six grounds, two accepted losses, two requirements out of scope and a theme removed; claim 2 moves the overview and review class-list checks, allocating the hub's totals box, button and caption line-height checks to overview-and-review inc-098 and the review's visually-hidden and summary-card class checks and last-card screenshot to overview-and-review inc-101, with the live animals class-name row inc-234 keeping the rest and dropping two screenshots already on the tests repo's main; claim 3 blocks the return links row inc-235 until the save and continue work (EUDPA-774, branch feat/EUDPA-774-save-and-continue-through-journey, workarea workareas/shared/eudpa-774) has merged and takes its commodities half out of the row. Coverage: every decision in Sam's quote is a verbatim claim; every identifier, ground, loss, allocation, drop and scope consequence the numbered claims add is an inferred claim with the ruling text it rests on quoted and the quote clause that supports the decision named in its note; what the ruling touches and leaves open is recorded as gap claims with an empty quote, including the review's fourth row inc-236, the quote naming no ticket, branch, workarea, theme or destination row, no unblocking check or date for inc-235, the theme removal and out-of-scope requirements the quote never names, the ruling's silence on the germinal-products set and on the high-risk plants frontend, whether the moved checks become acceptance criteria of their destination rows, and that no claim is marked New or as replacing an earlier conflict so none is matched to a report question or conflict.
